decisions.reason: After another year on the market, this tileable floor drain is a visible and strategically central extension of the core drainage portfolio, so sunk investment and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.

The stainless steel design grate supports the firm's design-led positioning and complements established drainage systems, making withdrawal relatively hard to justify while the business continues to grow.

Although pump-based shower solutions are more specialized and earlier related launches were withdrawn, this recently launched channel still benefits from fresh development investment, visible commitment, and fit with future-ready barrier-free bathroom solutions, so management would likely keep it for now.
